# Town of Newport municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 16; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Town of Newport (official website), Selectboard page: lists the selectboard as Steve Barrup, Richard Gosselin, and Jerry Waterman

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists Newport's selectboard as Steven Barrup (Chair), Karen Camber, and Richard Gosselin. The directory and the factory diverge from the town's own current page on the third seat: the 2024 annual report seats Waterman with a term expiring 2026, the 2026 warning elects a selectperson for a three-year term, and the town's current page presents Waterman as seated, so he is recorded re-elected and the town page governs; Camber is held as a straggler
Town of Newport, 2024 Annual Report, 'Town Officers' roster: lists selectboard members Richard Gosselin (to 2025), Jerry Waterman (to 2026), and Steve Barrup (to 2027)
Town of Newport (official website): the site's contact footer names Hannah Roberts as Town Clerk
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town clerk contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): lists Hannah Roberts as Newport's town clerk
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): names Hannah Roberts as Newport's town clerk
Town of Newport, 2024 Annual Report, 'Town Officers' roster: lists Denise Daigle as town clerk with a term to 2027; she has departed and Roberts is the clerk the current sources present
Town of Newport, 2026 Town Meeting Warning (annual meeting March 3, 2026): elects a Town Clerk for a three-year term at the March 3, 2026 meeting
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town treasurer contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): lists Hannah Roberts as Newport's town treasurer
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): names Hannah Roberts as Newport's town treasurer
Town of Newport, 2024 Annual Report, 'Town Officers' roster: lists Denise Daigle as town/school treasurer with a term to 2027; she has departed
Town of Newport, 2026 Town Meeting Warning (annual meeting March 3, 2026): elects a Town Treasurer for a three-year term at the March 3, 2026 meeting

Town of Newport, 2026 Town Meeting Warning (annual meeting March 3, 2026): elects a Moderator at the March 3, 2026 meeting; no outcome is published in any official source located, so the post is created without a membership
Town of Newport, 2024 Annual Report, 'Town Officers' roster: lists Moderator Richard Tetreault with a term to 2025; he is held as a straggler

Town of Newport, 2026 Town Meeting Warning (annual meeting March 3, 2026): elects a delinquent tax collector for a one-year term at the March 3, 2026 meeting; no outcome is published, so the post is created without a membership
Town of Newport, 2024 Annual Report, 'Town Officers' roster: lists Delinquent Tax Collector Denise Daigle with a term to 2025

Town of Newport, 2026 Town Meeting Warning (annual meeting March 3, 2026): elects a First Constable for a one-year term at the March 3, 2026 meeting; no outcome is published, so the post is created without a membership
Town of Newport, 2024 Annual Report, 'Town Officers' roster: lists First Constable Anthony Glover with a term to 2025; he is held as a straggler

Town of Newport, 2026 Town Meeting Warning (annual meeting March 3, 2026): elects a Second Constable for a one-year term at the March 3, 2026 meeting; no outcome is published, so the post is created without a membership
Town of Newport, 2024 Annual Report, 'Town Officers' roster: lists Second Constable Terry Dillon with a term to 2025; he is held as a straggler

Town of Newport, 2026 Town Meeting Warning (annual meeting March 3, 2026): elects three planning board members for three-year terms at the March 3, 2026 meeting; the board is an elected body in Newport

Town of Newport, 2024 Annual Report, 'Town Officers' roster: lists seven planning board members: Mike Beaumier and Bruce Sargent (to 2025), Ernest Choquette, Becky Therrien, and Linda Curtis (to 2026), and Ed Champine and Joanne Guyette-Worth (to 2027). Only Champine and Guyette-Worth, whose printed terms still run, are recorded; the five whose seats stood in 2025 or 2026 with unpublished outcomes are held as stragglers

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists seven Town of Newport justices of the peace elected November 5, 2024; the 2024 annual report names six, omitting William Bursey, and the listing governs

jp_election.name: Town of Newport Justice of the Peace Election 2024-11-05

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists seven Town of Newport justices of the peace elected November 5, 2024: Stephen Lowell, Jim Hilliker, Robert Hilliker, Linda Waterman, Maureen McGuire, Steve Edgerley, and William Bursey. The town's 2024 annual report names six of them, omitting Bursey; the listing governs. The listing publishes no vote totals or party labels and none are recorded
Town of Newport, 2024 Annual Report, 'Town Officers' roster: names justices of the peace Stephen Lowell, Jim Hilliker, Linda Waterman, Robert Hilliker, Steve Edgerley, and Maureen McGuire
